tha-ap321:1.1: Kandalīpupphiya.] Sindhuyā nadiyā tīre ahosiṃ kassako tadā / parakammāyane yutto parabhattaṃ apassito. // //
tha-ap321:2.1: Sindhum anucaranto 'haṃ Siddhatthaṃ jinam addasaṃ / samādhinā nisinnaṃ va satapattaṃ va pupphitaṃ. // //
tha-ap321:3.1: Sattakadalipupphāni vaṇṭe chetvān' ahan tadā / matthake abhiropesiṃ Buddha*ssādiccabandhu*no. // //
tha-ap321:4.1: Suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ sambuddham anukūle samāhitaṃ / tidhappabhinnaṃ mātaṅgaṃkuñjaraṃ va durāsadaṃ // //
tha-ap321:5.1: Tam aham upagantvāna nipakaṃ bhāvitindriyaṃ / añjaliṃ paggahetvāna avandiṃ satthuno ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap321:6.1: Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhipūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap321:8.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Kandalīpupphiyo thero i. g. a-ti.
